items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: I got with Harrison Bones, Yank and all them fellas, Buddy Johnson, Eddie Vincent and all them fellas, fast fellas, you see? And I used to pay attention to what they were doing... Sometimes Harrison was going to let me play sometime... With Chris Keller Band... obviously we could throw in the band

ctx.x: I'd like to know him. It was uh.

Let me see now I'll get him straight. It was uh. Alfred, Alfred Williams. Galle. Yank on trombone. Alfred Williams on drums. And uh. Thomas Copley was on bass. And Sam on trumpets. They had six pieces. The band was using six pieces. What did Galle play? He played a banjo. Who was the clarinet player? I didn't get that. Joe Watson. Joe Watson. Joe Watson. Joe Watson. Joe Watson. Joe Watson. Joe Watson.
